question: Which private-sector facility was commissioned for aerospace titanium production?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aerolloy Technologies**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Aerolloy Technologies**, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of **PTC Industries Limited**, commissioned a state-of-the-art facility dedicated to the production of **aerospace-grade titanium** castings and **superalloys**.
 
• The facility is situated in **Lucknow**, **Uttar Pradesh**, and forms a critical part of the **Uttar Pradesh Defence Industrial Corridor (UPDIC)**.
 
• It represents a milestone as the first **private-sector** facility in **India** capable of manufacturing complex **titanium** components for **aerospace** and **defence** applications, which were previously largely imported.
 
• The plant utilizes high-end technology such as **Vacuum Arc Remelting (VAR)** and **investment casting** to produce high-purity materials required for **aircraft engines** and **structural airframes**.
